rows.note: Use this colloquial all-purpose expression when something is done to an outrageously unacceptable degree, such as arriving inexcusably late.

example.english: You were inexcusably late for work today, by a whole hour!
example.traditional: 你今日返工遲到成個鐘，離晒譜咁喎！
